source: Python port of the user's Jesse strategy (spec.md) on data/BTCUSD_spot_1min_*.csv; one row per BOOK trade; net = return in R (R = 2.5 x ATR(14, 1h) / entry price), costs 0.07% of notional per side on every fill
note: the two books (ADX 40, 50) often enter at the same moment: rows are not independent; judge significance per book. t / tx are UTC candle-open times of the 15m candle at whose close the fill happens
